runtime_license_boundary.detail: The Cargo graph passes. The production static image still contains non-allowlisted Rust Unicode and incompletely reviewed runtime inputs. Experimental GNU server 10efeb22 uses external std and OpenSSL 3, has hashes for all 1,439 mapped source paths, and passed container, HTTPS, outbound TLS, and native HLS restart checks. Its external std contains non-allowlisted components and must not be bundled. Individual-file exceptions, unmapped content, external-runtime distribution, and production adoption remain uncleared; see runtime-link-audit.md.

jellyfin_12_behavior.detail: 104 of 364 operation declarations match; this does not measure compatible behavior. Current core ce34d9aa passed 31 container and 29 local HTTPS checks, including active FFmpeg shutdown and video resume after restart. Official web converts the ordered three-track album through AAC HLS, and official Qt 6 Desktop decodes the original AIFF queue through audio EOF. Independent reads confirm one added play per track and zero saved music resume. An isolated official Jellyfin 12.0.0 runtime supplied public music start/progress/stop observations; 18 short-track scenarios were replayed against the new Puffinbox image. Database checks cover repeated plays, duplicate starts/stops, ownership, user edits and audiobook resume. Earlier client results retain their image-specific scope in acceptance.md. ContributingArtistIds, explicit PlayCount writes and richer embedded music tags remain incomplete. General Desktop startup, broader clients, native AAC, arbitrary seeking, longer converted audio, audible quality and full Jellyfin 12 behavior remain unvalidated. Collections covers containing ancestors only; management and arbitrary membership remain incomplete. Native final-position inconsistency remains unexplained; music played state now follows the observed start policy. Ended duplicate stops preserve later user edits, a qualified difference from the reference.
